name: The Goddess Of Tears ~Restoration~
source:
Remake of [url=/v44753]The Goddess Of Tears[/url]. 

In the ancient land of Grandol, where countless myths of its founding still linger, there exists a legend — that the goddess Kalia is forever reborn here, in the form of the Holy Maiden.

Our heroine is such a maiden, fated from birth to carry the soul of the goddess.

Yet in these times, the royal family’s faith has faded. The Holy Maiden is no longer revered as a divine protector, but treated instead as a mere vessel — a means to preserve royal power, a weapon to be wielded in war.

To save her from this fate, her parents concealed her birth, and she grew up never knowing her own worth.

But the tides of history are relentless. They will sweep her into their current, changing her destiny forever.

Now, as the land is shrouded in a storm of blood, the tolling of the final bell echoes across the battlefield.

A romance and training simulation chronicling the life of a Holy Maiden who walked the war-torn era.


Remake Features:

Comprehensive scenario revisions — A clearer, more engaging story with richer romantic depth.

Fully illustrated R18 scenes — Every love interest will have his own R18 scenes.

Complete graphic overhaul — All visual assets newly drawn from the ground up.

[Translated from [url=https://mu-game.net/got/]the official website[/url].]
translation:
翻拍[url=/v44753]泪女神[/url]。

在格兰多尔这片古老的土地上，至今仍流传着无数关于其创建的神话，流传着这样一个传说——女神卡莉亚永远以圣女的形式重生于此。

我们的女主角就是这样一位少女，从出生起就注定承载着女神的灵魂。

然而在这个时代，王室的信仰已经消退。圣女不再被尊为神圣的保护者，而是仅仅被视为一种器皿——一种维护王权的手段，一种在战争中使用的武器。

为了让她摆脱这种命运，她的父母隐瞒了她的出生，而她在成长过程中从来不知道自己的价值。

但历史的潮流是无情的。他们将把她卷入他们的潮流中，永远改变她的命运。

如今，大地被血雨腥风所笼罩，最后的钟声在战场上回响。

一部浪漫和训练模拟游戏，记录了一位走过战乱时代的圣女的生活。


重制版特点：

全面的场景修改——更清晰、更吸引人的故事，更丰富的浪漫深度。

插图完整的R18场景 — 每个恋人都会有自己的R18场景。

完整的图形检修——所有视觉资产都是从头开始重新绘制的。

[翻译自[url=https://mu-game.net/got/]官网[/url]。]
